newsitem.title: USA: Republic Industries buys three waste cos.
newsitem.headline: Republic Industries buys three waste cos.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said on Thursday that it had acquired three solid waste companies for a sum of roughly $60 million of Republic common stock.

The three companies, National Serv-All, AAA Disposal and Elliott's Agri-Service Inc, were privately held and had combined 1996 revenue of about $38 million, Republic Industries said in a statement. The company intends to account for the acquisitions as a pooling of interests.
Republic Industries also said the principals in each of the three companies would continue in their respective roles.
Republic Industries Inc is a holding company with subsidiaries operating in automotive retailing, rental and financial services, as well as solid waste services.
